description:
One Girl, or Every Girl? Your 40-Day Campus Romance Begins

Return to college and start a 40-day challenge filled with romance, choices, ambition, and second chances.

You are back on campus with only 40 days to change your life. Study hard, build your social circle, earn money, improve yourself, and meet the girls who may completely change your story.

Every day matters. Every choice can lead to a new encounter, a new relationship, or a completely different ending.

Meet 6 Unique HeroinesFall for your childhood friend, a popular campus beauty who has always been by your side.

Get closer to a cool and mature teacher who hides a warmer side.

Win over a sharp-tongued rich girl who never says what she really feels.

Spend time with a cozy, introverted gamer girl who prefers staying in her own little world.

Meet a gentle twin sister with a kind heart.

Or discover the playful, unpredictable charm of her mischievous younger twin.

Choose one girl and build a sincere relationship, or explore multiple romance routes and see just how complicated campus love can get.

4,500 Random EncountersA quick conversation, a chance meeting, or a small decision can change everything.

Meet different characters in the library, clubs, classrooms, campus corners, and city streets. Build relationships through daily interactions, unexpected events, and meaningful choices.

No two playthroughs have to feel the same.

18 Date SpotsUnlock different date locations and spend special moments with the girl you like.

From casual hangouts to emotional conversations, from awkward first steps to real romantic tension, every date can shape your relationship and bring you closer to a new ending.

Make Your First MillionCollege life is not just about romance.

Study, exercise, join clubs, take part-time jobs, invest, trade stocks, and build your future step by step.

Start as an ordinary student and work your way toward becoming richer, smarter, more charming, and more confident.

40 Days. Your Choices. Your Romance.Will you become the devoted boyfriend who only has eyes for one girl?

Or will you try to balance multiple romances and become the ultimate campus heartbreaker?

In this 40-day campus life sim, the story is yours to write.

One true love, or a legendary dating life?

You decide.
description_short: My Dating Empire is a multi-ending romance simulator. Will you be a devoted lover, or a heart-stealing playboy? Return to college and experience the thrill of youthful romance through every encounter, conversation, and date.
